title: ClutchCommand
description: A simple plugin that asks you to clutch with a random item when you type /clutch.
body:
A simple command that gives you a random item to clutch with using /clutch.

Items and heights (in blocks):
- Bed, 44
- Honey/Hay, 100
- Cobweb, 200
- Twisting Vines, 200
- Sweet Berries, 200
- Water Bucket, 200
- Powder Snow Bucket, 200
- Bucket of Pufferfish, 200
- Bucket of Cod, 200
- Bucket of Salmon, 200
- Bucket of Tropical Fish, 200
- Bucket of Axolotl, 200
- Bucket of Tadpole, 200
